Why I built this

After 40+ trips to Disney World and 15 years helping friends plan them, I've learned that what a family actually needs and what they've heard they need are rarely the same thing. That gap is usually where the trip goes wrong. I built The Park Edit so that by the time your trip starts, the only thing left to do is enjoy it.

Everything before you leave.
Everything once you're there.

01

Your Pre Edit

Which resort is the right fit for your family. Every Lightning Lane selection for your specific dates: which rides, which tier, in the exact order to book them. When and where to eat so you're never waiting in a line with hungry kids. Personalized packing lists for each person, so nobody's overpacking and you're not buying sunscreen at $28 a bottle. And a step-by-step walkthrough of the My Disney Experience app so you know exactly how to use it before you walk through the gates.

02

Your Park Edit

Hour-by-hour itinerary for each day. Every ride mapped with expectations, restaurants already in the plan so nobody's stopping mid-day to figure out where to eat, breaks built in so no one melts down. Your Lightning Lanes book themselves automatically every time you tap into a ride, so you never have to stop and figure out what's next. And an SOS menu for when the day doesn't go to plan.

03

The Intel

The food worth stopping for and the spots most people walk straight past. Where to decompress when the day gets loud. The parade viewing spot nobody fights over. Park-specific knowledge that only comes from doing this enough times to know what actually matters.

Tell me about your trip.

01

Book a 30-minute call

This is where I learn everything. Your kids' ages, the rides they're ready for, what your family likes to eat, your pace, and what makes your kids light up. Everything goes into the plan.

02

Your Pre Edit is built

Soon after your call, your Pre Edit lands in your inbox. Everything is decided: your resort, your Lightning Lane selections for each park day, your dining reservations, your packing list. You don't have to figure anything else out before you leave.

03

Your Park Edit is delivered

A complete day-by-day plan personalized to your family. Once you're in the park, your Lightning Lanes manage themselves. Every booking made, monitored, and refreshed automatically so you can put your phone away and actually be there.
